features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: 32 Kyocera Industrial Printheads
items.desc: 32 water-based Kyocera printheads deliver up to 570 lm/hr output, making the K32 the highest-capacity configuration in the Homer series for non-stop large-scale production.

items.title: Intelligent Head Protection System
items.desc: All-around printhead anti-scratch protection detects obstacles during carriage movement and prevents contact damage, extending printhead life across continuous high-speed runs.

items.title: Industrial-Grade Belt Conveying System
items.desc: Stable, deviation-free belt transport maintains precise fabric positioning and consistent registration throughout every production run without manual adjustment.

items.title: Visual Operation Interface
items.desc: Smart touchscreen UI enables single-operator management of multiple machines, with easy job recovery and real-time production monitoring from one control point.

items.title: High-Speed Data Processing Server
items.desc: Large-memory industrial server ensures fast, uninterrupted data flow to all 32 printheads, eliminating processing delays even during complex, high-coverage design printing.

items.title: Automatic Moisturizing and Cleaning System
items.desc: Automated printhead moisturising and cleaning cycle reduces head wear, prevents nozzle blockages, and extends overall machine life during sustained high-volume production.

items.title: Diaphragm Pump Ink Supply System
items.desc: Durable diaphragm pump delivers stable, consistent ink pressure to all heads simultaneously, ensuring reliable colour output under continuous round-the-clock production conditions.

items.title: Excellent Noise Reduction
items.desc: High-speed linear motor paired with THK mute rail minimises operational noise, enabling comfortable working conditions during long production shifts at full machine speed.

items.title: Real-Time Ink and Air Pressure Monitoring
items.desc: Continuous system monitoring tracks ink and air pressure across all circuits, preventing mid-run interruptions and keeping production stable under all operating conditions.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: High-Volume Fashion Textile Production
fabrics.desc: Non-stop disperse printing on polyester sarees, dress materials, and fashion fabrics for large wholesale and export operations requiring maximum daily output.

fabrics.title: Large-Scale Export Garment Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: Reactive printing on cotton at high volume, consistently meeting ISO wash fastness standards required by international buyers across round-the-clock production shifts.

fabrics.title: Industrial Home Textile Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: Large-batch production of bedding, curtains, cushion covers, and upholstery across both cotton and polyester substrates for domestic retail and export markets.

fabrics.title: Jacquard and Textured Fabrics
fabrics.desc: High-resolution output on complex woven and jacquard structures where sharp pattern definition and consistent repeat registration are critical across large production volumes.

fabrics.title: Silk and Luxury Fabrics
fabrics.desc: Precise acid ink printing on silk, viscose, and premium fabrics for manufacturers supplying boutique fashion brands and luxury garment producers at scale.

fabrics.title: Multi-Buyer Job Work Operations
fabrics.desc: Wide fabric compatibility from 30 to 450 gsm and multi-ink support make the K32 ideal for large job work printing units serving diverse clients across different fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Custom and Hi-End Export Production
fabrics.desc: International fashion and home textile buyers requiring tight colour repeatability, consistent large-batch quality, and fast turnaround on repeat orders.
